description: The octahedral e₂ (where g₂ lives), from 2509.02354 eq (4.11-4.14, 4.19): a crossing's χ-coloring gives 4 tetrahedron shape-logs ζ⁰_{r,t,l,b}; the octahedral constraint ζ⁰_r+ζ⁰_l=ζ⁰_t+ζ⁰_b holds identically (z_r z_l=z_t z_b); e₁ is bar-odd (μ₀), e₂ bar-even (g₂) with the REAL paper shapes. e₂ is an explicit quadratic form in the 6 χ-coloring log-params; g₂ is its finite part at the deuteron trefoil coloring in the PINCHED limit (torus knot, ζ⁰∈ℤ, paper §5.2). Retracts an earlier a_r=−a_l guess. Getting the number needs the trefoil coloring solution + pinched limit (all DOF pinned, no fit) — the identified wall. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired.
tier: exact paper construction + symbolic identities (octahedral constraint, e₂ bar-parity, quadratic form) + pinched-limit obstruction; no fit

A_octahedral_constraint.meaning: z_r·z_l = z_t·z_b (octahedron edge-gluing), from paper eq 4.11-4.14.

B_bar_parity.meaning: with the REAL paper shapes: e₁ bar-odd (μ₀ first order), e₂ bar-even (g₂). Confirms FourDilogFirstOrder.e2_bar_even for the actual construction.

C_e2_quadratic_form.note: g₂ = value of this quadratic form at the deuteron trefoil coloring (pinched limit).

D_pinched_limit.pinched: deuteron trefoil crossings are pinched (ζ⁰∈ℤ, z_j→1, degenerate — torus knot, PR #4301). g₂ = finite part of e₂ in the pinched limit (paper §5.2).

correction.retracted: earlier a_r = −a_l guess — the r↔l transposition is in the Z_r/Z_l INDEX convolution, not the shapes; ζ⁰_r, ζ⁰_l independent.

wall.to_get_g2: solve the trefoil boundary-parabolic coloring (6 log-params pinned by ⟨a,b|a²b³⟩ + μ₁=μ₂ + substrate μ↔q₀) AND take the pinched-limit finite part.
wall.anti_fit: e₂ is a 6-var quadratic form; ALL coloring DOF must be pinned rigorously or the residual freedom is the wall. No coloring fabricated to hit g₂.
wall.scope: scope-(a): grounds g₂ in the exact paper construction + identifies the pinched-limit obstruction; does not derive g₂; nothing wired.

context.axis: Δ_λ binding — μ₀ −9% closure, g₂ = octahedral e₂ finite part (pinched limit)
